method: Real-time test: each candidate as it stood on the scoring date (its own vintage), scored against the first official release, with YoY and 3M changes computed inside that release. Month-end = first business day after the month. Mar 2020 - Jun 2021 excluded. Growth candidates in GDP units are read against a 1.8% trend; calibrations are expanding and use only months already released.

inflation.target: First-release core PCE YoY (level) and its 3M change (the map's vertical axis)

growth.target: First-release CFNAI-MA3 sign (the map's horizontal axis), own longest sample, month-end

quadrant.target: Both signs right (first-release quadrant), month-end, 2020-02 to 2026-09 ex-COVID, n = 40

rows.candidate: Official, one month old (the map without NOW)

gdp.target: Advance real GDP growth, % SAAR, day before release, ex-COVID quarters

market: Next-month S&P 500 return by the quadrant known at month-end (2014-2026 ex-COVID) does not sort in any version, hindsight included: gaps of about 1-1.5 pp on 25-45 months a quadrant (t about 1.5). The 10-year yield rose after REFLATION and fell after GOLDILOCKS in every version, on the same small samples. The map is descriptive, not a timing signal.
decision: Inflation: Cleveland core PCE nowcast. Growth: ADS 3M mapped onto CFNAI-MA3 (a small gain over the one-month-old print). GDPNow shown as a GDP tile, not on the map.
